flows.name: flow-batch-operator-slashing
flows.wire_behavior: Conflicting canonical deliveries open a dispute and pause epochs; electorate adjudication selects the winner, slashes losers, excludes them from scheduling, and resumes consensus. Depot shadow slashes remain on WIRE.
flows.cluster_only: Daemon submission and real external envelope transport.

flows.name: flow-batch-operator-termination
flows.wire_behavior: Missed duties accumulate at rotation cadence; threshold crossing terminates the operator, excludes future duty, and preserves claimable collateral/yield until paid.
flows.cluster_only: Stopping real daemons and observing wall-clock missed delivery.

flows.name: flow-emergency-stop
flows.wire_behavior: Freeze permits incoming custody and bonding but blocks releases, withdrawals and conversion; epoch budget does not accrue while frozen. Clear resumes pending work. Honest shortfall records evidence and pulls the cord.
flows.cluster_only: Real external freeze propagation, transaction refusal and payout retry.

flows.name: flow-emissions-soak
flows.wire_behavior: Epoch accrual, category distribution, floor/ceiling bounds and imported prelink rewards becoming claimable after authenticated linking.
flows.cluster_only: Multi-hour daemon/node stability, forks and external chain synchronization; native virtual time is not a soak.

flows.name: flow-liq-syndication
flows.wire_behavior: Canonical generic custody reports enter production msgch consensus, mint held shadow, retain held yield outside supply, close envelopes, suppress sequence replays and keep custody checks healthy.
flows.cluster_only: Real SOL staking/minting and permissionless yield reports, operator relay and liveness.

flows.name: flow-liq-yield
flows.wire_behavior: Custody-backed syndication releases to parked credit, linking delivers once, bonded yield enters pending, queueyield/tickyield sell through the real AMM, the index pays exact WIRE owed, and fee-rounded redemption queues the net amount.
flows.cluster_only: Real outpost native deposit, yield emission and payout execution.

flows.name: flow-node-owner-nft
flows.wire_behavior: Ethereum-bound registration creates the node owner, resource policy and tier counts; mismatched keys, malformed ETH identity, duplicates and full tiers reject without side effects.
flows.cluster_only: Ethereum NFT mint/ownership and upstream claim emission.

flows.name: flow-operator-collateral-deposit
flows.wire_behavior: Depot-native collateral moves into opreg custody, withdrawal reservation updates eligibility, maturity credits token-specific remit claims, and claims return exact principal. Generic dual shadow coverage supplements WIRE coverage.
flows.cluster_only: Node provisioning and live batch daemon duty while collateral changes.

flows.name: flow-producer-registration
flows.wire_behavior: Both required depot shadow assets must meet their own minimum; surplus cannot substitute, either withdrawal loses eligibility immediately, maturity/claim preserves asset identity. Producer registration, scoring, finalizer keys and scheduling enforce eligibility.
flows.cluster_only: Ethereum NFT provisioning and live producer process/block production. Generic NTA/NTB mirror the 2 LIQETH plus 2 LIQSOL policy; NFT tests remain Ethereum-specific.

flows.name: flow-syndication-challenge
flows.wire_behavior: Partial release then challenge freezes progress; INVALID burns held intake and released value from the forfeited bond, preserves recipient funds, pots surplus and pays challenger. VALID resumes. Generated backed sequences check conservation after transitions.
flows.cluster_only: Real external custody excess after invalidation and transport.

flows.name: flow-syndication-rate-limit
flows.wire_behavior: FIFO partial release, same-epoch no refill, epoch-bounded refill, oversized item draining and atomic over-budget redemption refusal.
flows.cluster_only: Live epoch-boundary synchronization and irreversible confirmation timing.

flows.name: flow-syndication-underwriting
flows.wire_behavior: Held intake needs collateral before release, exact fees accrue, unlinked credits park, authenticated links deliver, approval/claim obey windows, and pruned outcomes remain usable.
flows.cluster_only: Actual outpost deposits and operator transport.

flows.name: flow-yield-distribution
flows.wire_behavior: Staking reward credits linked/unmapped WIRE claims, suppresses stale external references, funds through accounting and liquid balance caps, and records shortfall.
flows.cluster_only: Ethereum mock emitter and real STAKING_REWARD transport.
